description:
Return kind, size and modification time of a path. `missing_ok=true` answers ok with `data.exists:false` for a missing path instead of `not_found`.
Use when: you need to know whether a path exists or how big it is. Use missing_ok=true to probe existence without failing the call.
Avoid when: you need the content (read_file).
Output: kind, size_bytes, modified_unix_seconds, exists when missing_ok=true. Missing path gives not_found (or ok with exists:false and missing_ok=true).

missing_ok.description: true = answer ok with exists:false for a missing path instead of not_found (default false).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
